provider: Liberty Group Limited (part of Standard Bank Group)
category: Retirement Annuity (Evolve Investment Range - Pre-Retirement Investment)
about: Applying for the Evolve Retirement Annuity Plan means applying for membership of the Lifestyle Retirement Annuity Fund, an approved retirement fund registered with the Registrar of Pension Funds. A single premium retirement annuity with the option to pay regular contributions, providing flexibility to structure the policy per investment requirements. Requires allocation of a specified portion of the investment to the Liberty Capped Tracker portfolio.

regulation_28.note: The Capped Tracker tracks the Top 40 index (100% equity); Liberty monitors exposure quarterly and may move non-compliant assets to a money market fund if the member does not act after notification.

access_to_benefits.ill_health_retirement: Allowed before 55 with no growth sharing deduction.

savings_component_withdrawal.description: Members may withdraw all or a portion of their Savings Component before retirement (once per year of assessment).
savings_component_withdrawal.growth_sharing_deduction: Applies if withdrawal taken in first 3 years and exceeds Regulation 28 compliant amount (Option 2).

access_to_benefits.vested_and_retirement_component: Cash lump sum withdrawals allowed before retirement under specific legislative conditions (e.g., total value below prescribed limit, emigration, non-SA-tax-residency for 3+ years).

additional_premiums.allocation_note: Ad hoc premiums replace the Capped Tracker portion with the equivalent uncapped Top 40 Tracker Portfolio, unless a different portfolio is specifically selected.

allocation_amount.target: At least 100% allocation of initial single premium if standard commission negotiated.

eligibility.member_type: Only individuals (natural persons); member is also the life assured (1 life assured, must be same as member).

death_benefit.formula: Greater of: (1) Investment value on date of notification of death plus investment enhancement, and (2) total of all contributions paid less legislative withdrawals and ongoing advisory fees paid.
death_benefit.payable_as: An annuity dependent on market annuity rates; may be commuted to a lump sum on death per current legislation.

retirement_benefit.vested_component: Vested Benefits can be taken as a lump sum or used to purchase an annuity; Non-Vested Benefits limited to max 1/3 as lump sum, balance must purchase an annuity.
retirement_benefit.savings_component: Can be taken fully as a lump sum, or transferred to the Retirement Component to purchase an annuity.
retirement_benefit.retirement_component: Cannot be accessed as a lump sum; full value must purchase an annuity.
retirement_benefit.de_minimis_threshold: R165,000 (if sum of Retirement Component + 2/3 of Non-Vested Benefits in Vested Component is below this, full amount can be taken as a lump sum).

fees.ongoing_advice_fee: 0% - 1% (excl. VAT); up to 1% after selected retirement date.
fees.early_termination_charge: Not applicable, though unit price adjusted for Growth Sharing Deduction within first 3 years on transfers/switches out of Capped Tracker.

growth_sharing.lower_target_return: Requires 40% invested in Capped Tracker; starts Growth Sharing earlier.
growth_sharing.after_3_years: Growth Sharing ends; Capped Tracker portion switches into Top 40 Tracker Portfolio.

guarantees.type: Return of contribution guarantee (C-type) on select portfolios.
guarantees.guarantee_dates: First guarantee date at 5 years; subsequent every 5 years thereafter and at normal retirement date.

portfolio_rules.guaranteed_portfolio_limit: Total initial considerations above R10,000,000 require special quote.

policy_term.maximum: Term to selected retirement age (between age 56 and 85 next birthday); open-ended if member does not retire at selected date.

surrenders_advances: Surrenders and advances are not allowed as per legislation; access only via legislative withdrawals and early/ill-health retirement.
taxation: Investment returns of underlying portfolios are not taxed under current legislation (no tax on interest/rental income or capital gains within the fund). Liberty issues tax certificates annually for new voluntary money invested. Lump sum withdrawals may be subject to tax per current Income Tax Act tables.

version_history.description: Naming convention for Evolve portfolios ('Evolve' becomes 'Liberty')
Changed max. OAF on RA/Preserver from 0.57% to 1.14%
